criteria.title: Separate request completion, buffer release and persistent-state claims.
criteria.task: Draw request states submitted, completed-success, completed-error, timed-out-unknown and flush-confirmed. Inject timeout after publication; prohibit buffer reuse and show why an error is not proof that no write occurred.
criteria.purpose: Request failure, device quiescence and persistent absence are distinct facts.

criteria.task: Run patterned write→flush→read and a fresh-guest reboot with the identical ordinary image. Retain backend cache options and full byte comparison; remove flush in a control and explain why a surviving value is still insufficient.
